input.answer:
The gasoline index (Canada, CPI, not seasonally adjusted, vector 41691136) rose 27.8% from September 2025 to September 2026.

Calculation: (267.6 − 209.4) / 209.4 = 58.2 / 209.4 = 0.2779, or 27.8%.

Index levels: 209.4 in 2025-09 and 267.6 in 2026-09 (1992=100 basis is not stated in the returned data; values are as published, scalar factor "units"). Source: Statistics Canada Table 18-10-0004, Consumer Price Index, monthly, not seasonally adjusted.
